applicability: T031 bounded local-IPC-only tool gateway candidate
statement: When a tool acquires or releases a service-emulation lease, the gateway **shall** delegate to the accepted T028 exclusive generation-bound lease, and conflict, expiry, or disconnect **shall** release or quarantine the lease without ambiguous ownership.
title: T031 requirement 012

successor_disposition.scope: linked gRPC gateway component (xverse_xcom_tool_gateway_grpc) lease delegation
successor_disposition.disposition: retained and clarified for this component
successor_disposition.successor: T039-F08 clarified that release is validated against the exact successful allocation: each allocation receives a fresh, session-scoped, strictly monotonic public identity that never aliases an earlier allocation within the session replay lifetime, and exhaustion is declined before the registry is touched. The generation-bound registry delegation, exact-session check, single-owned-lease boundary, and cleanup/quarantine semantics are unchanged.
